summary: Mint Incorporation Limited, a BVI company listed on the SEC as a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, reporting that its board approved a 10x increase in authorized share capital from 28,000,000 to 280,000,000 shares, split between Class A and Class B ordinary shares, and adopted a third amended and restated memorandum and articles of association reflecting that change. The filing attaches the new charter document and incorporates it into an existing F-3 registration statement. This is a routine corporate governance charter amendment to expand authorized capital, not a special situation. No transaction, offer, or strategic event is involved. What to watch: potential future equity issuances under the increased authorized capital.
